target.title: fix(tlon): send fragment image URLs as media
target.body:
Related: #104852

AI-assisted PR. I reviewed the diff and focused validation output.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Tlon users sending image media URLs with fragment suffixes, such as `https://cdn.example/image.png#preview`, would have those URLs classified as ordinary links instead of image blocks.

The outbound media story path already treats plain image URLs and image URLs with query strings as image blocks. Fragment-bearing image URLs were the missing sibling case.

## Why This Change Was Made

The change keeps the fix inside Tlon's local image URL classifier by allowing the image extension check to accept either `?query` or `#fragment` suffixes.

This does not change upload behavior, URL fetching, auth, gateway routing, persisted state, migrations, schema, upgrade behavior, or non-image URL handling. It only affects the final Tlon story classification branch for URLs whose path already ends in a known image extension.

## User Impact

Tlon users can now send image URLs that include fragments and still get the expected image media block instead of a plain clickable link when the Tlon send path builds a story from that URL.

For example, `https://cdn.example/image.png#preview` now follows the same media story classification path as `https://cdn.example/image.png` and `https://cdn.example/image.png?token=1`.

## Evidence

Before the fix, the focused local probe showed the mismatch:

```text
https://cdn.example/a.png          => true
https://cdn.example/a.png?token=1  => true
https://cdn.example/a.png#preview  => false
https://cdn.example/a.webp#v=1     => false
```

The focused regression test covers `buildMediaStory("caption", "https://cdn.example/image.png#preview")` and asserts that the URL is emitted as a `block.image` story verse instead of a link verse.

Reviewer-requested live proof is still pending. ClawSweeper asked for redacted evidence from a real Tlon setup showing the upload-fallback path preserves a `.png#fragment` URL and that Tlon renders it as image media. I have not claimed that live proof yet because this machine does not currently have Tlon ship credentials, a login code, or a configured target DM/group channel available.

When a real test setup is available, the intended proof should capture this path:

```text
sendMedia(mediaUrl: "https://[redacted]/image.png#preview")
→ uploadImageFromUrl(mediaUrl)
→ upload fallback returns the original fragment URL
→ buildMediaStory(text, fallbackUrl)
→ Urbit poke payload contains block.image.src
→ Tlon UI renders the message as image media, not a plain link
```

The redacted proof should preserve the `.png#preview` shape and `block.image.src` structure while hiding ship names, login code, cookies, private hosts, request IDs, channel identifiers, and credentials.

## Possible call chain / impact

The relevant source-level fallback chain is:

```text
extensions/tlon/src/channel.runtime.ts sendMedia
→ extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.ts uploadImageFromUrl
→ on upload failure, return the original imageUrl
→ extensions/tlon/src/urbit/send.ts buildMediaStory
→ extensions/tlon/src/urbit/story.ts isImageUrl
→ createImageBlock or createLinkInline
```

This PR only changes the Tlon-local classifier used by that story-building branch. Sibling behavior for plain image URLs, query-suffixed image URLs, upload success, auth, routing, and non-image URLs is intentionally unchanged.

## Validation

```text
git diff --check
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/tlon/src/urbit/send.test.ts
```

Result:

```text
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       3 passed (3)
```
